//: Codex hook config (matcher is a REGEX; use ".*", not "*"). Each section bakes its event name into the command; the adapter also falls back to the payload's hook_event_name. Place where your Codex version reads hooks (~/.codex/hooks.json or [hooks] in config.toml, or the repo-level .codex/ for trusted projects); adjust the path to the installed package. TOOL_MAP in adapters/codex.mjs maps Codex tool ids to canonical names. Node entry uses the sentinel `: skill-graph enter <node>` (see README) since Codex skills aren't tool calls.
